guide.summary: Todoist documents user-authorized OAuth2 with a registered app, so each customer connects their own account. The least-privilege documented scope for read-only task listing is data:read, which covers tasks, projects, labels and filters.
guide.recommendation: Todoist documents user-authorized OAuth2 with a registered app, so each customer connects their own account. The least-privilege documented scope for read-only task listing is data:read, which covers tasks, projects, labels and filters.

findings.title: OAuth2 app registration and authorization code flow
findings.detail: Developers create an app in the App Management Console and configure valid redirect URLs, which yields a Client ID and Client Secret. Users are redirected to https://app.todoist.com/oauth/authorize with client_id, scope and state. The code is then exchanged at https://api.todoist.com/oauth/access_token. Refresh tokens are the default for new apps.

findings.title: data:read grants read-only access to tasks
findings.detail: data:read grants read-only access to application data, including tasks, projects, labels and filters. It is the narrowest documented scope that covers listing tasks. Broader scopes such as data:read_write add write access and are not needed.

evidence.quote: data:read Grants read-only access to application data, including tasks, projects, labels, and filters.
data:read_write Grants read and write access to application data, including tasks, projects, labels, and filters. This scope includes task:add and data:read scopes.

findings.title: Active task listing endpoint and pagination
findings.detail: GET /api/v1/tasks returns the user's active tasks. Each result has a content field. Pagination is cursor-based: pass next_cursor back as cursor with the same parameters. limit defaults to 50 with a maximum of 200. Stop when next_cursor is null.

steps.title: Register the Todoist app and configure redirect URL
steps.detail: Create the app in the Todoist App Management Console and add one HTTPS redirect URL you control. Record the assigned Client ID and Client Secret as a confidential client. Do not claim registration is done until the console shows the credentials.
steps.doneWhen: The console shows a Client ID, Client Secret and the saved redirect URL.

steps.title: Test user consent at the Todoist authorization endpoint
steps.detail: A test Todoist user opens https://app.todoist.com/oauth/authorize?client_id=<CLIENT_ID>&scope=data:read&state=<STATE>&response_type=code&redirect_uri=<REDIRECT_URI> and approves. steps.title: Exchange the authorization code for an access token
steps.detail: POST the form fields to the documented token URL. Todoist documents client_id, client_secret and code as required, plus redirect_uri in the example. The documented token example has no grant_type for this exchange. A successful response returns access_token and, for refresh-enabled apps, refresh_token and expires_in. Run only after user-consent produced a code.

steps.title: List active task titles: first page
steps.detail: GET the first page of active tasks with the data:read access token. Expected: HTTP 200 with a results array of tasks and next_cursor. Task titles are in the content field. Boundary check: inspect the granted scope (data:read only) and the outgoing request log; send only GET requests. Never call create, update, complete or delete endpoints.
steps.doneWhen: HTTP 200 returns results[].content titles; next_cursor is a string or null.

evidence.quote: Get Tasks Get all active tasks for the user.
Responses 200 Successful Response
curl "https://api.todoist.com/api/v1/tasks?limit=50" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"

fields: ACCESS_TOKEN: access_token from token-exchange
limit: default 50, maximum 200
next_cursor: read from $.next_cursor in this response

steps.title: List active task titles: next page by cursor
steps.detail: Repeat the same request with the same parameters, adding cursor set to next_cursor from the prior response. Do not modify the cursor. Repeat until next_cursor is null, which is the documented end condition; then all active task titles have been listed.
steps.doneWhen: Each page returns results[].content; the final page has next_cursor null. Boundary check: inspect the actual grant against the documented access above; confirm the outgoing request log contains only the requested operations and no prohibited actions.
